class.name: SociQueryRequest
class.brief_description: Handle for a scheduled asynchronous SQL operation.
class.description: Handle for a scheduled asynchronous SQL operation. See res://addons/godot_soci/docs/API.md for usage examples, threading limitations and failure handling.

method.description: Whether this request completed, including cancellation.
